description:
Long Range Ebike for Adults - 330 lbs Max Load, 1500W Motor
Safety Certified Battery
UL2849 Safety-Certified 48V15Ah Battery: Reliable, secure power with impressive long -range performance, fully easing range anxiety for daily commuting.
Hidden-Integrated Key-Access Design: High-capacity battery neatly hidden inside the frame for a clean, streamlined look, with convenient key operation for secure power access and theft protection.
1500W Peak Motor
Peak 1500W High-Torque Motor: Defy steep inclines with ease. Our robust 1500W peak output powers you up demanding hills and through busy city streets effortlessly.
Precision-Tuned Power Delivery: Enjoy instant, confident acceleration that combines raw strength with smooth control, perfect for dynamic urban commuting and steady climbing.
Front Suspension
Lockable Front Suspension Mastery: This durable, adjustable fork actively absorbs road shocks and vibrations, delivering a smooth, stable ride over varied urban terrain.
Custom Tunable Comfort: With lockout functionality for precise control, it minimizes harsh impacts while maintaining responsive handling, perfectly balancing comfort and efficiency.
Smart Display
Full-Color Smart Display: Monitor real-time speed, battery level,PAS mode,and total mileage all in one clear, intuitive interface.
Adjustable Backlight Brightness: Ride with clear visibility day or night, with customizable brightness for any lighting condition.
All-in-One Ride Tracking: Stay on top of your journey and effortlessly hit your cycling goals with complete, real time riding data.
Bright headlight and Taillight
Bright front and rear lighting system: Equipped with high-visibility headlight and taillight for maximum safety during night rides.
Unlimited Riding Freedom: Cruise confidently at any hour, breaking time limits with enhanced safety and riding comfort.
Disc brake
Precision Stopping Power: Featuring 160 brake rotors, the disc brake system delivers noticeably shorter braking distances for confident, secure stops in any condition.
Low-Maintenance Reliability: Engineered for consistent performance with minimal upkeep, offering strong, responsive braking control ride after ride.
